member.summary: Exposes Xbox 360 (PowerPC) data cache control instructions as methods that the JIT compiler emits inline.
member.remarks: Each method addresses the cache block containing the address _base + offset. These methods are security critical and take unmanaged pointers, so they are not available to application code.

member.name: M:Microsoft.Xbox.Cache.dcbt(System.Int32,System.Void*)

member.summary: Writes the cache block containing the specified address back to memory if it was modified, keeping it in the cache.
